fact: In March 2026 an AfDB-funded (PASG) call for expressions of interest sought trainers to sensitise Mali's procurement actors on dematerialising procurement procedures through SIGMAP, covering buyer and bidder obligations and electronic signature.
title: AMI - Mali - Sensibilisation et formation des acteurs de la passation des marchés sur la dématérialisation des procédures de passation des marchés publics à travers le SIGMAP - PASG
